summary_en: This phase 2 study tests ipilimumab and nivolumab given with low-dose stereotactic body radiation therapy before surgery in people with resectable non-small cell lung cancer. Ipilimumab is given as one intravenous dose on day 1, and nivolumab is given intravenously on days 1, 15 and 29, while stereotactic body radiation therapy is given in one or two treatments completed by day 3. The main outcome measured is pathologic response, including major and complete pathologic response, in patients who go on to surgery.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 prueba ipilimumab y nivolumab junto con radioterapia estereotáctica corporal de dosis baja antes de la cirugía, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas resecable. El ipilimumab se administra en una dosis intravenosa el día 1, y el nivolumab se administra por vía intravenosa los días 1, 15 y 29, mientras que la radioterapia estereotáctica corporal se da en una o dos sesiones, completadas antes del día 3. El resultado principal que se mide es la respuesta patológica, incluida la respuesta patológica mayor y la respuesta patológica completa, en los pacientes que se someten a cirugía.
who_for: Pathologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer, resectable stage IB to IIIB
Candidates for surgery with intent to remove the tumor completely (R0)
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0-1
Lung function adequate to tolerate the planned lung resection
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within the stated limits
